checks: checkpoint and source receipt path plus SHA-256
resolved config file SHA-256 and checkpoint config/source hash
state parse, serialize/restore byte-stable canonical fingerprint
legal action mask exactly matches LifelineGame legal points plus PASS
PASS index equals n*(n+1)/2 and is legal in every nonterminal fixture
illegal priors receive zero probability and all legal priors/value are finite
Grid-GNN physical-edge and Topology-GNN full logical-edge relation encoding
one no-root-noise PUCT-16 action per fixture is legal and replayable

gen_size.unique_trajectory_key: eval_size + opening_prefix + continuation action-index sequence; ignore black/white slot labels

d16_v2.unique_continuation_key: post-prefix continuation action-index sequence only; ignore black/white slot labels

gate_conditions: GEN-SIZE formal_ready=true and independent verification passed
D16-v2 formal_ready=true and independent verification passed
85/85 P0 tasks complete; zero failed, missing, truncated, or unreplayable games
canonical and independent W/D/L, intervals, task hashes, source hashes, config hashes, and checkpoint hashes agree
remaining wall-clock budget is at least two times the measured P1 smoke estimate
P1 cannot delay P0 aggregation, verification, or D17_D19_RESULTS.md freeze
any new rental, fee, or card-type change has explicit user confirmation

statistics.score_definition: win=1, draw=0.5, loss=0 from focal agent A

gen_size_primary_interval.method: Student t interval across five training-seed means
gen_size_primary_interval.seed_mean_definition: mean of 32 paired-color policy-seed pair scores

gen_size_secondary_interval.resample: training-seed IDs and shared paired-color policy-seed pair IDs independently; take the selected crossed cells

d16_v2_primary_interval.resample: five training-seed IDs and 32 shared opening-cluster IDs independently; take selected seed x opening cells and retain all four games per cell

d16_v2_secondary_interval.method: Student t interval across five training-seed means

autodl.readiness_contract: read real frozen checkpoint and materialized opening; parse manifest; verify size/shape; build every model kind; perform CPU forward
autodl.gpu_smoke_contract: continuous real CUDA forward/backward/optimizer on disposable model clone; calibrate batch, AMP, and data supply; write throughput profile under AUTODL_WORK_DIR
autodl.readiness_failure_action: fix local code; do not rent
autodl.gpu_smoke_failure_action: repair current instance dependencies/config; do not change card by default
